notes:
High-level: SMB inbound, very product-led. They build a lightweight call-notes + coaching product for mid-market SDR teams. Mainly self-serve so hosted API a good fit. Key pain: transcripts contain PII (emails, phone numbers, customer addresses).

Quoted from discovery call: "We want transcripts to be searchable but we can't store raw PII for longer than X days — legal will require retention controls and redaction options."

Requirements summary (shorthand):
- Workload: near-realtime call-summary generation + embeddings for search and coaching. Low-concurrency for now (10-30 concurrent calls), peak token rate modest (100k tokens/day).
- Latency: 300-600ms per short-turn generation desired for live coaching overlay; batch embedding jobs OK to be longer.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget; will prefer lower-cost variants and clear per-token pricing for pilot.
- Model preferences: open-models or Redwood-verified small-medium models; quantized options welcome.
- Routing/fallback: prefer single-region (NA) hosted; want fallback to cheaper model if cost spikes.
- Security: SOC2 preferred, audit logs, retention controls, API-level redaction guidance, KMS for keying (optional).

Next steps / ask list:
- Send short doc: hosted API retention & redaction patterns + sample policy + how to configure TTL for cached transcripts. (ACTION: Jordan)
- Provision sandbox API key with header-only access for dev team and attach usage quota. (ACTION: Aisha)
- Quick tech call with eng lead to validate sample flow (30m). (Schedule: week of 2026-02-15)

Notes on buyer map: primary champion is Head of Product (Maya Lopez) — cares about time-to-market and cost. Legal/Compliance will review retention language (secondary reviewer). Eng lead (Samir Patel) will evaluate integration complexity. No CSM yet — likely small ARR if move forward.

Short-term risk: if the hosted API lacks documented TTL/redaction controls they will stutter on procurement. Good timeline: small pilot in 4-6 weeks if sandbox + retention answers OK.
customer_concerns: PII handling and retention first-class; need clear docs + canned retention policies; ask if Redwood stores user data for model tuning (they asked explicitly).
resolution_guidance: Recommend: provide example retention TTL, redaction patterns, opt-out of data logging for pilot, and a short FAQ sentence: "Hosted API does not use customer request content for model training; audit logs available on request."
